title: rafnia cuneifolia var. obovata
intro: Rafnia cuneifolia var. obovata, commonly known as Rafnia, is a plant species that belongs to the family Fabaceae. It is known for its medicinal properties, including the ability to treat various health conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and skin irritations. The health benefits of Rafnia include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of reducing pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Rafnia include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
